parsed.why: No criminalisation, gender-identity anti-discrimination law and bias sentencing exist, but documented organised violence against public LGBT events, police-cancelled screenings and attacks, hostile polling, and a worsening trend leave outed visitors facing hostility with uneven recourse.

Penal code punishing same-sex conduct with life, documented police extortion and violence against visibly trans people, airport arrests, a murdered trans advocate, 260 violations in 2025 rising sharply, and post-2024 Islamist mobilisation outweigh nominal hijra recognition.

Same-sex conduct legal, no trans-specific criminal or facility exposure, large tolerated Prides and courts striking anti-gender-identity measures; offset by official mockery of gender markers, a municipality's recurring Pride ban, and no gender-identity hate-crime coverage.

Unused sodomy statute, no trans-specific offence, parades and a drop-in centre operate unhindered, health ethics rules bar discrimination; offset by an unenforced morality lever, hostile parliament overriding marriage recognition, and no gender-identity anti-discrimination recourse.

Cross-dressing ban struck down in 2022 but dress-code policing and official discrimination persist, public-morality laws are strictly enforced with documented prosecutions, same-sex conduct carries seven years, no document change, LGBTQ material blocked, HIV-positive foreigners deported.
